column1: # EXP-R2-227: does a conditioned arm generate what it is asked for?
# The GPU half of D1.h, and the only half that needs a card. The HMMER/Pfam-A
# oracle, the InterPro release and the UniRef50 corpus are staged on the
# workstation and not in this pod, so the instrument build, the frozen class
# queue, the per-class instrument anchors and the scoring all run on CPU there;
# what runs here is sampling.
# ONE CARD, ONE CELL PER SLOT. The allocation exposes three cards and a
# concurrent official campaign holds two of them, so every cell is scheduled on
# the free card and the slots are the sequence. A cell whose card is not idle is
# REFUSED and not launched, which is the property that keeps this campaign from
# displacing that one.
# STAGING BEFORE DISPATCH. The frozen class queue is evidence rather than code,
# so it does not travel inside the snapshot. Copy it to
# <results_run_dir>/class_queue.json before launching -- the same shape
# EXP-R2-226 used for wildtypes.json and cohort.json -- and it is nobody's
# expect basename, because an input staged beside a result is not completion.
# Every cell that reads it verifies its content digest and refuses a queue that
# has drifted.
# SLOTS 1-6 ARE THE INTERFACE GATE. "An arm fails a load, self-check or
# rendering check -> that arm stops. Do not substitute another conditioned arm;
# there are only two." Each self-check samples two continuations of 24 tokens at
# a configuration this campaign does not measure at, and --stage generate refuses
# an arm whose self-check artefact is absent or failed. So the gate is executable
# rather than a sentence in a log entry.
# SLOTS 7-8 BEFORE 9-12, deliberately. The registration's operational sequence
# runs the text positive control's attainability screen before the protein
# generations: the control shows the estimand returns a strong positive with
# instrument error removed, so a weak protein reading cannot be blamed on the
# estimand. Nothing about the ordering is relaxed to save time.
# bfloat16 ON EVERY ARM, self-check and generation alike. The released
# checkpoints are float32 (ZymCTRL, ProtGPT2, ProGen2-medium), float16
# (ProLLaMA) and bfloat16 (the two text arms), so this is a declared cast,
# identical across arms and conditions, which is what a within-arm contrast
# between conditions requires. It is recorded in every artefact.
# Everything else is the stage's own frozen default: top-p 0.95, temperature
# 1.0, no top-k, no repetition penalty, at most 400 new tokens, 200 generations
# per (arm x class x condition), campaign seed 20260826. --stage generate
# refuses any of those moved.
